# v0.10 Notes — closing the audit gaps

This release answers the v0.9 audit table point by point.

## Fixed

### Real .unity scene files (was: "partial — generated by wizard only")
- `Assets/Scenes/MainMenu.unity`, `Assets/Scenes/Race_NeonCity.unity`,
  `Assets/Scenes/Garage.unity` now ship in the repo.
- Every script and folder has a stable `.meta` with a deterministic GUID
  (md5 of the asset path), so scene references survive regeneration.
- The Setup Wizard now skips scene files that already exist — it only adds
  them to Build Settings and configures Android Player Settings.
- Scene YAML uses the 2022.3 format, which Unity 6 upgrades automatically
  on open (matching the project's `Rigidbody.linearVelocity` API level).

## Added

### Cockpit / first-person view
- `ChaseCamera` already had 6 modes (Chase/Close/Far/Hood/Cockpit/Bumper) —
  v0.10 makes them reachable: a **CAM button** on the race HUD cycles modes.
- `CockpitInterior.cs`: procedural dashboard, steering wheel that turns with
  the player's actual steering input (`ArcadeCarController.SteeringInput`),
  red neon ambient strips — visible only in Cockpit/Hood modes.

### Time-of-day presets (was: night-only)
- `TrackConfig.timeOfDay` (Night / Sunset / Dawn / Day) drives
  `SkyLightingBootstrap` presets: sun color/intensity/angle, ambient, fog,
  camera background. Career and quick-race configs can ship any preset.

### Reference-look HUD (from the screenshots)
- Radial speedometer cluster bottom-right: dark gauge disc, cyan speed ring
  (fill = km/h / 320), magenta inner nitro ring, digital speed + gear + unit.
- Live leaderboard top-left: position numbers + racer names, "YOU" row
  highlighted cyan, refreshed 4x/second from `RacePositionTracker`.
- CAM mode button top-right.

### Reference-look garage
- Colored class badges (S purple, A orange, B green) on the hero panel and
  on every carousel cell.
- Coins pill top-right (live).
- RACE (cyan) / CUSTOMIZE (magenta) buttons. RACE selects the car and starts
  the race; CUSTOMIZE opens a live panel cycling PAINT / RIMS / NEON — each
  change applies real materials immediately and persists
  (`OwnedCarSave.neonId` is new).
- Bottom carousel strip of all 5 cars, click to switch, active highlighted.

### Localization skeleton (EN/AR)
- `Localization/L10n.cs`: string table + `Language` enum, persisted in
  `SaveData.language`. Settings has a LANGUAGE row; menu, garage, customize
  and settings labels pull from the table.
- **Honest limitation:** uGUI `Text` does not shape Arabic (letters render
  disconnected) and has no RTL layout. For production Arabic, switch the
  runtime UI to TextMeshPro and import an Arabic font (e.g. Noto Naskh or
  Cairo) — the string values are already correct and switchable; only the
  rendering layer needs the upgrade. This is documented rather than faked.

### Services architecture (Ads / IAP / Leaderboards)
- `Services/GameServices.cs`: `IAdService`, `IIapService`,
  `ILeaderboardService` with swappable implementations.
- REAL today: `LocalLeaderboard` (per-track best times in SaveSystem,
  auto-submitted at race finish) and the persisted premium-unlock flag.
- Honest stubs: `NoOpAdService` / `NoOpIapService` log clearly and (in the
  editor only) simulate success so reward flows are testable. Wiring a real
  SDK = implement the interface and set `GameServices.Ads/Iap` — no game
  code changes. The offline core never touches the network.
- Multiplayer remains out of scope by the original constraint
  (offline-first), unchanged in v0.10.

## Not done (deliberate)
- AdMob/Unity Ads SDK integration: requires packages + store accounts — the
  architecture is ready, the SDK wiring cannot be faked from source.
- Online leaderboards: same story (plug a backend behind the interface).
- Day/night *cycle* over a race: presets per race instead (deterministic,
  performance-friendly on mobile).
